' ============================================================================
' X-TYPE - a horizontal shoot-'em-up for the ZX Spectrum Next
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd
' ============================================================================
' NTC BASIC. An original game: new ship, new orb, new enemies, new stages, new sound. The tilemap
' scrolls the terrain (the hardware scrolls it a pixel a frame; a new column of tiles is written
' every 8 pixels, under the clip window's edge), the 128 hardware sprites are everything else.
'   Q A O P  move      SPACE  tap: shoot - hold: charge, let go: the wave beam
'   Z  the orb: send it out, call it back (or swap sides when it is behind you)
' (Joystick 1 works too: fire shoots and charges; the second button is the orb.)
' Pick-ups: S speed, P power (single, double, spread), O the orb. Two stages, then it all again, harder.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo
#Const SplashNoPlain     ' (the plain Cyborg Unicorn screen isn't used here)

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- sprite slots (128)
Const SL_SHIP = 0         ' 2
Const SL_FLAME = 2
Const SL_ORB = 3
Const SL_GLOW = 4
Const SL_WAVE = 5         ' 5
Const SL_SHOT = 10        ' 16
Const SL_EBUL = 26        ' 8
Const SL_PICK = 34        ' 3
Const SL_ENM = 37         ' 16 x 2
Const SL_BOSS = 69        ' 12
Const SL_BOOM = 81        ' 10
Const SL_SCORE = 91       ' 8
Const SL_LIFE = 99        ' 3
Const SL_GAUGE = 102      ' 8

Const NEN = 15             ' enemies 0 - 15
Const NSH = 15             ' shots 0 - 15
Const NBU = 7              ' enemy bullets 0 - 7
Const NEXP = 9              ' explosions 0 - 9

' enemy types
Const E_DRONE = 1, E_DART = 2, E_SWOOP = 3, E_CRAWL = 4, E_TURRET = 5, E_SNAKE = 6, E_CARRIER = 7, E_MINE = 8, E_ORBIT = 9
Const E_MID = 10, E_BOSS = 11, E_SEG = 12

' the orb's states
Const O_NONE = 0, O_FRONT = 1, O_OUT = 2, O_FREE = 3, O_BACK = 4, O_REAR = 5

Dim g_intFrame As Integer, g_intA4 As Integer, g_intScr As Integer, g_intScx As Integer
Dim g_intWc As Integer, g_intWcell As Integer, g_intLen As Integer, g_intEvp As Integer
Dim g_intStage As Integer, g_intLoop As Integer, g_intLives As Integer, g_intJoy As Integer
Dim g_intLo As Integer, g_intHi As Integer, g_intHsLo As Integer, g_intHsHi As Integer, g_intScoreDirty As Integer
Dim g_intPx As Integer, g_intPy As Integer, g_intSpd As Integer, g_intPow As Integer, g_intTilt As Integer
Dim g_intOrb As Integer, g_intOx As Integer, g_intOy As Integer, g_intOdir As Integer
Dim g_intHeld As Integer, g_intCharge As Integer, g_intGauge As Integer, g_intZwas As Integer, g_intCool As Integer
Dim g_intDead As Integer, g_intInv As Integer, g_intWon As Integer, g_intTerrOn As Integer
Dim g_intWv As Integer, g_intWx As Integer, g_intWy As Integer, g_intWl As Integer, g_intWh As Integer
Dim g_intKeyWas As Integer, g_intSc As Integer
Dim g_arrCe(1023) As Byte, g_arrFl(1023) As Byte
Dim g_arrSK(15) As Integer, g_arrSX(15) As Integer, g_arrSY(15) As Integer, g_arrSVx(15) As Integer, g_arrSVy(15) As Integer
Dim g_arrEt(15) As Integer, g_arrEx(15) As Integer, g_arrEy(15) As Integer, g_arrEa(15) As Integer, g_arrEb(15) As Integer
Dim g_arrEc(15) As Integer, g_arrEh(15) As Integer, g_arrEw(15) As Integer, g_arrEg(15) As Integer, g_arrEp(15) As Integer
Dim g_arrEd(15) As Integer
Dim g_arrBk(7) As Integer, g_arrBx(7) As Integer, g_arrBy(7) As Integer, g_arrBvx(7) As Integer, g_arrBvy(7) As Integer
Dim g_arrPk(2) As Integer, g_arrPx(2) As Integer, g_arrPy(2) As Integer, g_arrPd(2) As Integer, g_arrPa(2) As Integer
Dim g_arrXk(9) As Integer, g_arrXx(9) As Integer, g_arrXy(9) As Integer, g_arrXf(9) As Integer, g_arrXc(9) As Integer, g_arrXs(9) As Integer
Dim g_arrTx(63) As Integer, g_arrTy(63) As Integer
Dim g_intTr As Integer, g_intSnake As Integer
Dim g_intBk As Integer, g_intBx As Integer, g_intBy As Integer, g_intBhp As Integer, g_intBt As Integer, g_intBd As Integer
Dim g_intBw As Integer, g_intBh As Integer, g_intBm As Integer, g_intBhit As Integer

Splash.Show 1                  ' Cyborg Unicorn, then DEVELOPED USING NTC BASIC
Splash.Show 2
Setup
Do
    Title
    Game
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- set up
Sub Setup()
    Tiles.Init
    Spr.Init
    GfxData.Load
    Sfx.Init
    Pals.Set 0
    Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 155 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255   ' the tilemap's clip: 312 pixels across
    Nx.Seed 2026
    g_intHsLo = 0 : g_intHsHi = 0
End Sub

Sub Vsync()
    Frame
    Spr.Show
    Sfx.Update
    g_intFrame = g_intFrame + 1
    If (g_intFrame And 3) = 0 Then g_intA4 = g_intA4 + 1
    g_intJoy = Keys.Joystick(0)
End Sub

' a key press (not held): 1 the key was just pressed
Function Pressed(k As Integer) As Integer
    Dim intR As Integer
    intR = 0
    If Keys.Down(k) Then
        If g_intKeyWas = 0 Then intR = -1
        g_intKeyWas = k + 1
    ElseIf g_intKeyWas = k + 1 Then
        g_intKeyWas = 0
    End If
    Pressed = intR
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the terrain
' the stage's heights into the two arrays, in pixels (ceiling's bottom, floor's top as a height)
Sub LoadStage(n As Integer)
    Dim intI As Integer, intB As Integer
    If n = 1 Then
        g_intLen = Stages.LEN1 : intB = Stages.TERR1 : g_intEvp = Stages.EV1
    Else
        g_intLen = Stages.LEN2 : intB = Stages.TERR2 : g_intEvp = Stages.EV2
    End If
    For intI = 0 To g_intLen - 1
        g_arrCe(intI) = Stages.B(intB + intI) * 8
        g_arrFl(intI) = Stages.B(intB + g_intLen + intI) * 8
    Next
    Pals.Set n - 1
End Sub

' one column of the world into a cell column of the map
Sub PutCol(w As Integer, cell As Integer)
    Dim intC As Integer, intF As Integer, intR As Integer, intY As Integer, intT As Integer, intH As Integer, intW As Integer
    intW = w
    If intW >= g_intLen Then intW = g_intLen - 1
    intC = g_arrCe(intW) : intF = 256 - g_arrFl(intW)
    intY = 0
    For intR = 0 To 31
        intT = 0
        If intY + 8 <= intC Then
            intH = (w * 3 + intR * 7) And 3
            If g_intStage = 1 Then
                intT = GfxData.T_ROCKA
                If intH = 0 Then intT = GfxData.T_ROCKB
                If intY + 8 = intC Then intT = GfxData.T_EDGEC
            Else
                intT = GfxData.T_PLATEB
                If intH = 0 Then intT = GfxData.T_PLATEA
                If intH = 1 And (w And 1) = 0 Then intT = GfxData.T_PLATEC
                If intY + 8 = intC Then intT = GfxData.T_FLIPC
            End If
        ElseIf intY >= intF Then
            intH = (w * 3 + intR * 7) And 3
            If g_intStage = 1 Then
                intT = GfxData.T_ROCKA
                If intH = 0 Then intT = GfxData.T_ROCKB
                If intY = intF Then intT = GfxData.T_EDGEF
            Else
                intT = GfxData.T_PLATEB
                If intH = 0 Then intT = GfxData.T_PLATEA
                If intH = 1 And (w And 1) = 0 Then intT = GfxData.T_PLATEC
                If intY = intF Then intT = GfxData.T_FLIPF
            End If
        Else
            intH = (w * 7 + intR * 13) And 127
            If intH = 0 Then intT = GfxData.T_STARA
            If intH = 1 Then intT = GfxData.T_STARB
            If intH = 2 Then intT = GfxData.T_STARC
        End If
        Tiles.Put cell, intR, intT
        intY = intY + 8
    Next
End Sub

' the whole screen from world column c0 on (the scroll set to match)
Sub BuildAll(c0 As Integer)
    Dim intI As Integer
    For intI = 0 To 39
        PutCol c0 + intI, intI
    Next
    g_intWc = c0 + 40 : g_intWcell = 0
    g_intScr = c0 * 8 : g_intScx = 0
    Tiles.Scroll 0, 0
End Sub

' a pixel-a-frame scroll: every 8 pixels the next column goes in, in the cell just left of the screen
Sub ScrollStep()
    g_intScr = g_intScr + 1
    g_intScx = g_intScx + 1
    If g_intScx >= 320 Then g_intScx = 0
    If (g_intScr And 7) = 0 Then
        PutCol g_intWc, g_intWcell
        g_intWc = g_intWc + 1
        g_intWcell = g_intWcell + 1
        If g_intWcell >= 40 Then g_intWcell = 0
    End If
    Tiles.Scroll g_intScx, 0
End Sub

' is a box (centre cx, cy, half sizes hw, hh) in the rock?
Function TerrHit(cx As Integer, cy As Integer, hw As Integer, hh As Integer) As Integer
    Dim intA As Integer, intB As Integer, intC As Integer, intK As Integer, intR As Integer
    intR = 0
    intA = g_intScr + cx - hw
    If intA < 0 Then intA = 0
    intB = g_intScr + cx + hw
    If intB < 0 Then intB = 0
    For intC = Fx.Shr3(intA) To Fx.Shr3(intB)
        intK = intC
        If intK >= g_intLen Then intK = g_intLen - 1
        If g_arrCe(intK) > cy - hh Then intR = -1
        If 256 - g_arrFl(intK) < cy + hh Then intR = -1
    Next
    TerrHit = intR
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- score
Sub AddScore(p As Integer)
    g_intLo = g_intLo + p
    If g_intLo >= 10000 Then
        g_intLo = g_intLo - 10000
        g_intHi = g_intHi + 1
    End If
    g_intScoreDirty = 1
End Sub

Sub ShowScore()
    Dim intV As Integer, intD As Integer, intK As Integer, intX As Integer
    ' 8 digits: hi (4) then lo (4); the last digit is always 0 (the points are tens): g_intLo * 10
    intX = 8
    For intK = 0 To 7
        Spr.Put SL_SCORE + intK, intX + intK * 9, 3, GfxData.S_DIGIT, GfxData.P_DIGIT
    Next
    DigitsAt g_intHi, 0
    DigitsAt g_intLo, 4
    Spr.Put SL_SCORE + 7, 8 + 7 * 9, 3, GfxData.S_DIGIT, GfxData.P_DIGIT
    g_intScoreDirty = 0
End Sub

Sub DigitsAt(v As Integer, first As Integer)
    Dim intV As Integer, intD As Integer, intK As Integer
    intV = v
    For intK = 0 To 3
        intD = 0
        If intK = 0 Then
            Do While intV >= 1000
                intV = intV - 1000 : intD = intD + 1
            Loop
        ElseIf intK = 1 Then
            Do While intV >= 100
                intV = intV - 100 : intD = intD + 1
            Loop
        ElseIf intK = 2 Then
            Do While intV >= 10
                intV = intV - 10 : intD = intD + 1
            Loop
        Else
            intD = intV
        End If
        Spr.Put SL_SCORE + first + intK, 8 + (first + intK) * 9, 3, GfxData.S_DIGIT + intD, GfxData.P_DIGIT
    Next
End Sub

Sub ShowLives()
    Dim intK As Integer
    For intK = 0 To 2
        If intK < g_intLives - 1 Then
            Spr.Put SL_LIFE + intK, 100 + intK * 18, 2, GfxData.S_LIFE, GfxData.P_LIFE
        Else
            Spr.Hide SL_LIFE + intK
        End If
    Next
End Sub

Sub ShowGauge()
    Dim intK As Integer, intF As Integer
    For intK = 0 To 7
        intF = 0
        If g_intCharge >= (intK + 1) * 6 Then intF = 1
        If g_intCharge >= 48 Then intF = 2
        Spr.Put SL_GAUGE + intK, 200 + intK * 12, 239, GfxData.S_GAUGE + intF, GfxData.P_GAUGE
    Next
    g_intGauge = g_intCharge
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub Title()
    Dim intT As Integer, intK As Integer, intGo As Integer
    Spr.HideRange 0, 128
    Pals.Set 0
    Tiles.Scroll 0, 0
    Tiles.Fill 0
    For intK = 0 To 5
        Spr.Put intK, 40 + intK * 40, 36, GfxData.S_LOGO + intK, GfxData.P_LOGO + Spr.Scale2
    Next
    Tiles.Text 8, 12, "AN ORIGINAL SHOOT-'EM-UP"
    Tiles.Text 8, 15, "Q A O P    MOVE"
    Tiles.Text 8, 16, "SPACE      FIRE - HOLD: BEAM"
    Tiles.Text 8, 17, "Z          ORB OUT - ORB BACK"
    Tiles.Text 8, 19, "S SPEED   P POWER   O ORB"
    Tiles.Text 4, 29, "(C) 2026 CYBORG UNICORN PTY LTD"
    Tiles.Text 12, 22, "HI"
    PutNum 15, 22, g_intHsHi
    PutNum 19, 22, g_intHsLo
    Do While Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace)
        Vsync
    Loop
    intGo = 0 : intT = 0
    Do While intGo = 0
        Vsync
        intT = intT + 1
        If (intT And 32) Then
            Tiles.Text 10, 25, "PRESS SPACE TO START"
        Else
            Tiles.Text 10, 25, "                    "
        End If
        If Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyEnter) Or (g_intJoy And Keys.JoyFire1) Then intGo = 1
    Loop
End Sub

Sub PutNum(x As Integer, y As Integer, v As Integer)
    Dim intV As Integer, intD As Integer
    intV = v : intD = 0
    Do While intV >= 1000
        intV = intV - 1000 : intD = intD + 1
    Loop
    Tiles.Put x, y, 48 + intD
    intD = 0
    Do While intV >= 100
        intV = intV - 100 : intD = intD + 1
    Loop
    Tiles.Put x + 1, y, 48 + intD
    intD = 0
    Do While intV >= 10
        intV = intV - 10 : intD = intD + 1
    Loop
    Tiles.Put x + 2, y, 48 + intD
    Tiles.Put x + 3, y, 48 + intV
End Sub

' text on the scrolled map: a banner at row 13, from the screen's cell 10 on
Sub Banner(s As String)
    Dim intI As Integer, intC As Integer, intCell As Integer
    intC = Fx.Shr3(g_intScx) + 10
    For intI = 1 To Len(s)
        intCell = intC + intI - 1
        If intCell >= 40 Then intCell = intCell - 40
        Tiles.Put intCell, 13, Asc(Mid$(s, intI, 1))
    Next
End Sub

Sub Delay(n As Integer)
    Dim intI As Integer
    For intI = 1 To n
        Vsync
    Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the game
Sub Game()
    Dim intR As Integer
    g_intLives = 3 : g_intLo = 0 : g_intHi = 0 : g_intStage = 1 : g_intLoop = 0
    g_intPow = 0 : g_intSpd = 0 : g_intOrb = O_NONE
    intR = 1
    Do While intR = 1
        intR = PlayStage(g_intStage)
        If intR = 1 Then
            g_intStage = g_intStage + 1
            If g_intStage > 2 Then
                g_intStage = 1 : g_intLoop = g_intLoop + 1
            End If
        End If
    Loop
    If g_intHi > g_intHsHi Or (g_intHi = g_intHsHi And g_intLo > g_intHsLo) Then
        g_intHsHi = g_intHi : g_intHsLo = g_intLo
    End If
End Sub

' the stage's checkpoint at or before world column c
Function Checkpoint(n As Integer, c As Integer) As Integer
    Dim intK As Integer, intR As Integer, intV As Integer, intBase As Integer
    If n = 1 Then intBase = Stages.CP1 Else intBase = Stages.CP2
    intR = 0 : intK = 0
    Do
        intV = Stages.W(intBase + intK)
        If intV = 30000 Then Exit Do
        If intV <= c Then intR = intV
        intK = intK + 1
    Loop
    Checkpoint = intR
End Function

Sub ClearAll()
    Dim intI As Integer
    For intI = 0 To NEN : g_arrEt(intI) = 0 : Next
    For intI = 0 To NSH : g_arrSK(intI) = 0 : Next
    For intI = 0 To NBU : g_arrBk(intI) = 0 : Next
    For intI = 0 To 2 : g_arrPk(intI) = 0 : Next
    For intI = 0 To NEXP : g_arrXk(intI) = 0 : Next
    g_intWv = 0 : g_intBk = 0 : g_intBd = 0 : g_intSnake = 0
    Spr.HideRange 0, 128
    g_intScoreDirty = 1
End Sub

' the event pointer to the first event from world column c on
Sub SeekEvents(n As Integer, c As Integer)
    Dim intK As Integer, intBase As Integer
    If n = 1 Then intBase = Stages.EV1 Else intBase = Stages.EV2
    intK = intBase
    Do While Stages.W(intK) < c
        intK = intK + 4
    Loop
    g_intEvp = intK
End Sub

Sub ResetShip()
    g_intPx = 60 : g_intPy = 128 : g_intTilt = 0
    g_intHeld = 0 : g_intCharge = 0 : g_intCool = 0 : g_intDead = 0 : g_intInv = 100
    g_intOrb = O_NONE
End Sub

' play stage n: 1 cleared, 0 game over
Function PlayStage(n As Integer) As Integer
    Dim intCp As Integer, intR As Integer
    g_intStage = n
    LoadStage n
    intCp = 0
    g_intPow = 0 : g_intSpd = 0
    ClearAll
    Tiles.Fill 0
    BuildAll 0
    SeekEvents n, 40
    ResetShip
    g_intTerrOn = 1 : g_intWon = 0
    ShowLives
    ShowScore
    ShowGauge
    Banner "STAGE"
    Delay 60
    BuildAll 0
    intR = -1
    Do While intR < 0
        Vsync
        Tick
        If g_intDead >= 100 Then
            ' the ship has been gone a while: a life lost
            g_intLives = g_intLives - 1
            If g_intLives <= 0 Then
                intR = 0
            Else
                intCp = Checkpoint(n, Fx.Shr3(g_intScr))
                ClearAll
                BuildAll intCp
                SeekEvents n, intCp + 40
                g_intPow = 0 : g_intSpd = 0
                ResetShip
                ShowLives
            End If
        End If
        If g_intWon > 150 Then intR = 1
    Loop
    If intR = 0 Then
        Banner "GAME OVER"
        Delay 150
    Else
        Banner "STAGE CLEAR"
        Delay 120
    End If
    PlayStage = intR
End Function

' one frame of the game
Sub Tick()
    Dim intI As Integer
    g_intSc = 0
    If g_intBk = 0 And g_intWon = 0 Then
        ScrollStep
        g_intSc = 1
    End If
    If g_intWon > 0 Then g_intWon = g_intWon + 1
    Spawns
    If g_intDead = 0 Then
        Ship
    Else
        g_intDead = g_intDead + 1
    End If
    Shots
    Enemies
    If g_intBk > 0 Then Boss
    Bullets
    Pickups
    Booms
    Hud
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the ship
Sub Ship()
    Dim intS As Integer, intFire As Integer, intZ As Integer, intTop As Integer
    intS = 2 + g_intSpd
    g_intTilt = 0
    If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or (g_intJoy And Keys.JoyUp) Then g_intPy = g_intPy - intS : g_intTilt = 1
    If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or (g_intJoy And Keys.JoyDown) Then g_intPy = g_intPy + intS : g_intTilt = 2
    If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or (g_intJoy And Keys.JoyLeft) Then g_intPx = g_intPx - intS
    If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or (g_intJoy And Keys.JoyRight) Then g_intPx = g_intPx + intS
    If g_intPx < 24 Then g_intPx = 24
    If g_intPx > 292 Then g_intPx = 292
    If g_intPy < 20 Then g_intPy = 20
    If g_intPy > 236 Then g_intPy = 236
    If g_intInv > 0 Then g_intInv = g_intInv - 1
    If g_intCool > 0 Then g_intCool = g_intCool - 1
    ' fire / charge
    intFire = 0
    If Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or (g_intJoy And Keys.JoyFire1) Then intFire = 1
    If intFire = 1 Then
        g_intHeld = g_intHeld + 1
        If g_intHeld = 1 Then FireShots
        If g_intHeld > 14 And g_intCharge < 48 Then
            g_intCharge = g_intCharge + 1
            If g_intCharge = 10 Or g_intCharge = 20 Or g_intCharge = 30 Or g_intCharge = 40 Then Sfx.Play 1, 240 - g_intCharge * 3, -2, 8, 6, 0
        End If
    Else
        If g_intCharge >= 10 And g_intWv = 0 Then FireWave
        g_intHeld = 0 : g_intCharge = 0
    End If
    ' the orb
    intZ = 0
    If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyZ) Or (g_intJoy And Keys.JoyFire2) Then intZ = 1
    If intZ = 1 And g_intZwas = 0 Then OrbButton
    g_intZwas = intZ
    OrbMove
    ' terrain and being hurt
    If g_intInv = 0 Then
        If TerrHit(g_intPx, g_intPy, 12, 5) Then Kill
    End If
    If g_intDead > 0 Then Exit Sub
    ' the sprites
    Spr.Put SL_SHIP, g_intPx - 16, g_intPy - 8, GfxData.S_SHIP + g_intTilt * 2, GfxData.P_SHIP
    Spr.Put SL_SHIP + 1, g_intPx, g_intPy - 8, GfxData.S_SHIP + g_intTilt * 2 + 1, GfxData.P_SHIP
    Spr.Put SL_FLAME, g_intPx - 26, g_intPy - 8, GfxData.S_FLAME + (g_intA4 And 1), GfxData.P_FLAME
    If g_intInv > 0 And (g_intFrame And 2) Then
        Spr.Hide SL_SHIP : Spr.Hide SL_SHIP + 1
    End If
    If g_intCharge > 3 Then
        intTop = 0
        If g_intCharge >= 10 Then intTop = 1
        If g_intCharge >= 20 Then intTop = 2
        If g_intCharge >= 30 Then intTop = 3
        Spr.Put SL_GLOW, g_intPx + 14, g_intPy - 8, GfxData.S_GLOW + intTop, GfxData.P_GLOW
    Else
        Spr.Hide SL_GLOW
    End If
    If g_intCharge <> g_intGauge Then ShowGauge
End Sub

Sub NewShot(x As Integer, y As Integer, vx As Integer, vy As Integer, k As Integer)
    Dim intI As Integer
    For intI = 0 To NSH
        If g_arrSK(intI) = 0 Then
            g_arrSK(intI) = k : g_arrSX(intI) = x : g_arrSY(intI) = y : g_arrSVx(intI) = vx : g_arrSVy(intI) = vy
            Exit For
        End If
    Next
End Sub

Sub FireShots()
    Sfx.Play 0, 40, 4, 9, 6, 0
    If g_intPow = 0 Then
        NewShot g_intPx + 20, g_intPy, 8, 0, 1
    ElseIf g_intPow = 1 Then
        NewShot g_intPx + 20, g_intPy - 4, 8, 0, 1
        NewShot g_intPx + 20, g_intPy + 4, 8, 0, 1
    Else
        NewShot g_intPx + 20, g_intPy, 8, 0, 1
        NewShot g_intPx + 16, g_intPy - 4, 6, -3, 2
        NewShot g_intPx + 16, g_intPy + 4, 6, 3, 3
    End If
    If g_intOrb = O_FRONT Or g_intOrb = O_FREE Then NewShot g_intOx + 8, g_intOy, 8, 0, 4
    If g_intOrb = O_REAR Then NewShot g_intOx - 8, g_intOy, -8, 0, 5
End Sub

Sub FireWave()
    Dim intL As Integer
    intL = 1
    If g_intCharge >= 20 Then intL = 2
    If g_intCharge >= 30 Then intL = 3
    If g_intCharge >= 40 Then intL = 4
    g_intWv = 1 : g_intWx = g_intPx + 16 : g_intWy = g_intPy : g_intWl = intL + 1
    g_intWh = 8
    If intL >= 3 Then g_intWh = 16
    Sfx.Play 1, 400, -12, 15, 24, 0
End Sub

Sub OrbButton()
    If g_intOrb = O_FRONT Then
        g_intOrb = O_OUT

Sub NewEnemy(t As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, a As Integer)

    For intI = 0 To NEN

    g_arrEw(intE) = 7 : g_arrEh(intE) = 6 : g_arrEg(intE) = 2 : g_arrEp(intE) = 10
    If t = E_DRONE Then
        g_arrEg(intE) = 2 + g_intLoop
    ElseIf t = E_DART Then
        g_arrEg(intE) = 1 : g_arrEh(intE) = 5
    ElseIf t = E_SWOOP Then
        g_arrEg(intE) = 2 : g_arrEp(intE) = 20

    ElseIf t = E_CRAWL Or t = E_TURRET Then

        If a = 0 Then g_arrEy(intE) = 256 - g_arrFl(intCol) - 8 Else g_arrEy(intE) = g_arrCe(intCol) + 8
        g_arrEg(intE) = 3 + g_intLoop : g_arrEp(intE) = 15
        g_arrEb(intE) = 40 + Rnd(60)

        For intN = 0 To 63

        Next

        For intN = 1 To 5

        Next
    ElseIf t = E_CARRIER Then

Sub Enemies()
    Dim intE As Integer, intT As Integer, intX As Integer, intY As Integer, intF As Integer, intA As Integer, intK As Integer, intCol As Integer
    Dim intP As Integer, intFl As Integer
    ' the snake's trail
    If g_intSnake > 0 Then
        g_intTr = g_intTr + 1
    End If
    For intE = 0 To NEN
        intT = g_arrEt(intE)
        If intT > 0 Then
            g_arrEa(intE) = g_arrEa(intE) + 1
            intA = g_arrEa(intE)
            intX = g_arrEx(intE) : intY = g_arrEy(intE)
            intFl = 0
            If intT = E_DRONE Then
                intX = intX - 1 - (intA And 1)
                intY = g_arrEb(intE) + Stages.W(Stages.SINE + (intA And 63))
                If g_intLoop > 0 And intA = 50 Then Aim intX, intY, 2
            ElseIf intT = E_DART Then
                intX = intX - 4
            ElseIf intT = E_SWOOP Then
                intX = intX - 2
                If (intA And 1) = 0 And g_arrEd(intE) < 63 Then g_arrEd(intE) = g_arrEd(intE) + 1
                If g_arrEc(intE) = 0 Then
                    intY = 20 + Stages.W(Stages.DIVE + g_arrEd(intE))
                Else
                    intY = 236 - Stages.W(Stages.DIVE + g_arrEd(intE))
                End If
                If intA = 40 Then Aim intX, intY, 2
            ElseIf intT = E_CRAWL Then
                intX = intX - g_intSc
                If (intA And 1) = 0 Then intX = intX - 1
                intCol = Fx.Shr3(g_intScr + intX)
                If intCol >= g_intLen Then intCol = g_intLen - 1
                If intCol < 0 Then intCol = 0
                If g_arrEc(intE) = 0 Then
                    intY = 256 - g_arrFl(intCol) - 8
                Else
                    intY = g_arrCe(intCol) + 8 : intFl = Spr.MirrorY
                End If
            ElseIf intT = E_TURRET Then
                intX = intX - g_intSc
                If g_arrEc(intE) = 1 Then intFl = Spr.MirrorY
                g_arrEb(intE) = g_arrEb(intE) - 1
                If g_arrEb(intE) <= 0 And intX > 24 And intX < 300 Then
                    Aim intX, intY, 2 + g_intLoop
                    g_arrEb(intE) = 110 - g_intLoop * 25
                    Sfx.Play 0, 200, 5, 8, 6, 0
                End If
                ' the barrel's aim
                intK = 2
                If g_intPx < intX - 24 Then
                    intK = 0
                    If g_arrEc(intE) = 0 And intY - g_intPy > intX - g_intPx Then intK = 1
                    If g_arrEc(intE) = 1 And g_intPy - intY > intX - g_intPx Then intK = 1
                ElseIf g_intPx > intX + 24 Then
                    intK = 4
                    If g_arrEc(intE) = 0 And intY - g_intPy > g_intPx - intX Then intK = 3
                    If g_arrEc(intE) = 1 And g_intPy - intY > g_intPx - intX Then intK = 3
                End If
                g_arrEd(intE) = intK
            ElseIf intT = E_SNAKE Then
                intX = intX - 2
                intY = g_arrEb(intE) + Stages.W(Stages.SINE + (intA And 63))
                g_arrTx(g_intTr And 63) = intX : g_arrTy(g_intTr And 63) = intY
            ElseIf intT = E_SEG Then
                If g_arrEt(g_arrEc(intE)) <> E_SNAKE Then
                    RemoveEnemy intE
                    intT = 0
                Else
                    intK = (g_intTr - g_arrEb(intE) * 5) And 63
                    intX = g_arrTx(intK) : intY = g_arrTy(intK)
                End If
            ElseIf intT = E_CARRIER Then
                intX = intX - 1
                If (intA And 1) = 0 Then g_arrEd(intE) = g_arrEd(intE) + 1
                intY = g_arrEb(intE) + Stages.W(Stages.SINE + (g_arrEd(intE) And 63)) \ 2
            ElseIf intT = E_MINE Then
                intX = intX - 1
                If (intA And 3) = 0 Then
                    If g_intPy > intY Then intY = intY + 1 Else If g_intPy < intY Then intY = intY - 1
                End If
            ElseIf intT = E_ORBIT Then
                intX = intX - 2
                intY = g_arrEb(intE) + 100 + Stages.W(Stages.SINE + ((intA * 2) And 63))
                If (intA And 31) = 0 Then NewBullet intX - 8, intY, -3, 0
            End If
            If intT > 0 Then
                If intX < -20 Or intY < 4 Or intY > 262 Then
                    RemoveEnemy intE
                Else
                    g_arrEx(intE) = intX : g_arrEy(intE) = intY
                    ' being hit by the ship / the orb
                    If g_intDead = 0 And g_intInv = 0 Then
                        If Abs(intX - g_intPx) < g_arrEw(intE) + 12 And Abs(intY - g_intPy) < g_arrEh(intE) + 6 Then Kill
                    End If
                    If g_intOrb > O_NONE And (g_intFrame And 3) = 0 Then
                        If Abs(intX - g_intOx) < g_arrEw(intE) + 8 And Abs(intY - g_intOy) < g_arrEh(intE) + 8 Then Hurt intE, 1
                    End If
                End If
                ' the sprites (the enemy may have just died)
                If g_arrEt(intE) > 0 Then
                    intT = g_arrEt(intE)
                    If intX < 0 Then
                        Spr.Hide SL_ENM + intE * 2 : Spr.Hide SL_ENM + intE * 2 + 1
                    ElseIf intT = E_DRONE Then
                        Spr.Put SL_ENM + intE * 2, intX - 8, intY - 8, GfxData.S_DRONE + (g_intA4 And 1), GfxData.P_DRONE
                    ElseIf intT = E_DART Then
                        Spr.Put SL_ENM + intE * 2, intX - 8, intY - 8, GfxData.S_DART, GfxData.P_DART
                    ElseIf intT = E_SWOOP Then
                        Spr.Put SL_ENM + intE * 2, intX - 8, intY - 8, GfxData.S_SWOOP + (g_intA4 And 1), GfxData.P_SWOOP
                    ElseIf intT = E_CRAWL Then
                        Spr.Put SL_ENM + intE * 2, intX - 8, intY - 8, GfxData.S_CRAWL + (g_intA4 And 1), GfxData.P_CRAWL + intFl
                    ElseIf intT = E_TURRET Then

Sub StartBoss(t As Integer, a As Integer)

    g_intBx = 360 : g_intBy = 128

    ElseIf a = 1 Then

        g_intBk = 3 : g_intBw = 30 : g_intBh = 22 : g_intBhp = 140 + g_intLoop * 30

    If g_intBhp <= 0 Then

    AddScore 1

    Dim intI As Integer
    For intI = 0 To 11
        Spr.Hide SL_BOSS + intI

        AddScore 200

        AddScore 500

    g_intBk = 0

Sub Boss()
    Dim intW As Integer, intH As Integer, intCx As Integer, intCy As Integer, intP As Integer, intT As Integer, intPal As Integer, intTx As Integer
    Dim intFast As Integer
    g_intBt = g_intBt + 1
    intTx = 262
    If g_intBk = 1 Then intTx = 270
    If g_intBd > 0 Then
        ' dying: blasts all over it
        g_intBd = g_intBd + 1
        If (g_intBd And 3) = 0 Then

            Sfx.Play 2, 600 + Rnd(500), 15, 12, 10, 1
        End If
        If g_intBd > 80 Then
            Boom g_intBx, g_intBy, 1
            Sfx.Play 2, 1500, 30, 15, 50, 1
            BossGone
            Exit Sub
        End If
    ElseIf g_intBx > intTx Then
        g_intBx = g_intBx - 1
    Else
        intFast = 0
        If g_intBhp * 2 < 60 Then intFast = 1
        If g_intBk = 1 Then
            g_intBy = 128 + Stages.W(Stages.SINE + (g_intBt And 63))
            g_intBm = g_intBm - 1
            If g_intBm <= 0 Then
                Aim g_intBx - 14, g_intBy, 2 + g_intLoop
                g_intBm = 55 - intFast * 20
                Sfx.Play 0, 200, 5, 8, 6, 0
            End If
        ElseIf g_intBk = 2 Then
            g_intBy = 128 + Stages.W(Stages.SINE + ((g_intBt \ 2) And 63))
            g_intBm = g_intBm - 1
            If g_intBm <= 0 Then
                NewBullet g_intBx - 34, g_intBy, -3, -2
                NewBullet g_intBx - 34, g_intBy, -3, 0
                NewBullet g_intBx - 34, g_intBy, -3, 2
                If intFast Then
                    NewBullet g_intBx - 34, g_intBy, -3, -1
                    NewBullet g_intBx - 34, g_intBy, -3, 1
                End If
                Aim g_intBx - 34, g_intBy, 3
                g_intBm = 70 - intFast * 25
                Sfx.Play 0, 150, 6, 10, 8, 0
            End If
            If (g_intBt Mod 200) = 199 Then NewEnemy E_DART, g_intBx - 20, g_intBy, 0
        Else
            g_intBy = 128 + Stages.W(Stages.SINE + ((g_intBt * 2) And 63))
            g_intBm = g_intBm - 1
            If g_intBm <= 0 Then
                NewBullet g_intBx - 34, g_intBy - 12, -4, 0
                NewBullet g_intBx - 34, g_intBy + 12, -4, 0
                Aim g_intBx - 34, g_intBy, 3
                If intFast Then
                    NewBullet g_intBx - 34, g_intBy, -3, -2
                    NewBullet g_intBx - 34, g_intBy, -3, 2
                End If
                g_intBm = 50 - intFast * 18
                Sfx.Play 0, 120, 6, 10, 8, 0
            End If
            If (g_intBt Mod 160) = 159 Then NewEnemy E_DRONE, g_intBx - 20, g_intBy, 0
        End If
        ' touching it
        If g_intDead = 0 And g_intInv = 0 Then
            If Abs(g_intBx - g_intPx) < g_intBw + 12 And Abs(g_intBy - g_intPy) < g_intBh + 6 Then Kill
        End If
        If g_intOrb > O_NONE And (g_intFrame And 3) = 0 Then
            If Abs(g_intBx - g_intOx) < g_intBw + 8 And Abs(g_intBy - g_intOy) < g_intBh + 8 Then HurtBoss 1
        End If
    End If
    If g_intBk = 0 Then Exit Sub
    If g_intBhit > 0 Then g_intBhit = g_intBhit - 1
    ' draw it
    If g_intBk = 1 Then
        intW = 2 : intH = 2 : intP = GfxData.S_GUARD : intPal = GfxData.P_GUARD
    ElseIf g_intBk = 2 Then
        intW = 4 : intH = 3 : intP = GfxData.S_BOSS1 : intPal = GfxData.P_BOSS1
    Else
        intW = 4 : intH = 3 : intP = GfxData.S_BOSS2 : intPal = GfxData.P_BOSS2
    End If
    If g_intBhit > 0 Then intPal = GfxData.P_BOOM
    For intCy = 0 To intH - 1
        For intCx = 0 To intW - 1
            If g_intBx - intW * 8 + intCx * 16 >= 0 And g_intBx - intW * 8 + intCx * 16 < 320 Then
                Spr.Put SL_BOSS + intCy * intW + intCx, g_intBx - intW * 8 + intCx * 16, g_intBy - intH * 8 + intCy * 16, intP + intCy * intW + intCx, intPal
            Else
                Spr.Hide SL_BOSS + intCy * intW + intCx
            End If
        Next
    Next
End Sub

' Splash - the Cyborg Unicorn splash screen for the ZX Spectrum Next (NTC BASIC, platform zxn): the
' QR code of https://cyborgunicorn.com.au filling the screen, the unicorn's head in its middle (or a
' plain code), CYBORG UNICORN under it. It fades in (1 second), stays (3 seconds) and fades out (1
' second); a key cuts it short (a quick fade out). One command:
'
'   Splash.Show 1        ' with the unicorn
'   Splash.Show 0        ' the plain code (no hole, bigger modules)
'   Splash.Show 2        ' DEVELOPED USING NTC BASIC: the code of https://cyborgunicorn.com.au/ntc.htm
'
' Both, one after the other: Splash.Show 1 : Splash.Show 2. Each screen costs about 4K of main RAM;
' one the program doesn't show can be left out, with a #Const before this class (on the command
' line, the program's .bas before Splash.cls; or cli.js --const=):
'
'   #Const SplashNoLogo      ' no unicorn screen
'   #Const SplashNoPlain     ' no plain screen
'   #Const SplashNoNtc       ' no NTC BASIC screen
'
' Show with a screen that was left out does nothing.
'
' It can go in a bank (the screens and the code with it; main RAM keeps only the call stub):
'
'   Option Page SplashPg Loaded 20 = Splash
'   Option Page 0, &H4000, &H4000     ' the window reserved, page 0 (NTC 20261105-6 on)
'
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - made by tools/mksplash.py (do not edit the data by hand)
'
' The picture is a ZX Spectrum screen (assets/cyborgunicorn-logo.scr, -plain.scr, ntcbasic.scr), packed into this
' class (the unicorn's screen 3838 bytes packed, the plain one 4147, NTC BASIC's 4236), unpacked onto the ULA's screen (bank 5's page 10, put in slot 6 for it). The
' fade is the ULA's palette (32 entries: inks 0-15, papers 16-31, 9-bit colours through NextReg
' #44) stepped through 17 brightnesses.
' Show keeps and puts back what it changes: the ULA's palette, NextRegs #15 (sprites), #43 (the
' palette chosen), #56 (slot 6), #68 (the ULA), #69 (Layer 2), #6B (the tilemap). For its 5
' seconds only the ULA shows (white border: the code's quiet zone); the border is black after.
' The ULA's screen itself is left with the picture on it (the program draws its own over it).
' A key held when Show starts (the one that ran the program) doesn't count until it is let go.
' The internal jumps come back through JP (IX); no CALL, no PUSH (NTC's threaded code).
Option Explicit
Option SaveNex "SPLASH.DAT", 20     ' <--- NEW   the packed screens (tools/splashdat.py makes build/SPLASH.DAT) in page 20 of the NEX file; it was a Banks() Sub with MMU and INCBIN lines

' the picture packed at src unpacked, everything kept, the palette black
Private Sub Begin(ByVal src As Integer)
#asm
; SPW r: NextReg r = A (BC lost); SPR r: A = NextReg r
  MACRO SPW r
            ex af, af'
            ld a, r
            ld (ntc_zxsel), a
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            ex af, af'
            inc b
            out (c), a
  ENDM
  MACRO SPR r
            ld a, r
            ld (ntc_zxsel), a

            pop hl

            SPR #43

            SPW #43

            xor a

spb_k:

            SPW #40

            SPW #69
            ld a, (spl_r6b)
            and #7F
            SPW #6B
            ld a, (spl_r15)
            and #FE
            SPW #15
            ld a, (spl_r68)
            and #7F
            SPW #68
            ld a, 7                 ; the border white (its colour is paper 7's: faded too)
            out (#FE), a

            SPW #57

            ld a, d
            cp #DB
            jr c, spu_lp
            ld a, (spl_r57)         ; slot 7 put back
            SPW #57
            ret

            db #00, #00, #03, #01, #E0, #00, #E3, #01, #1C, #00, #1F, #01, #FC, #00, #FF, #01
#endasm
End Sub

' where each screen is packed (none: the screen left out, 0)
#If SplashNoLogo = 0 Then
Private Function LogoAt() As Integer
#asm
            ld a, 40
            ld (spl_bank), a
            ld de, #E000
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ret
#endasm
End Function
#End If

#If SplashNoPlain = 0 Then
Private Function PlainAt() As Integer
#asm
            ld a, 41
            ld (spl_bank), a
            ld de, #E000
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ret
#endasm
End Function
#End If

#If SplashNoNtc = 0 Then
Private Function NtcAt() As Integer
#asm
            ld a, 40
            ld (spl_bank), a
            ld de, #EEFE
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ret
#endasm
End Function
#End If

' the palette at brightness k (0 black - 16 full)
Private Sub Level(ByVal k As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; spl_lev + k * 64
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld de, spl_lev
            add hl, de
            xor a
            SPW #43
            xor a
            SPW #40
            ld e, 64
spl_l:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            SPW #44
            dec e
            jr nz, spl_l
#endasm
End Sub

' everything put back as it was (the border black)
Private Sub Finish()
#asm
            xor a
            SPW #43
            xor a
            SPW #40
            ld hl, spl_pal
            ld e, 64
spf_l:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            SPW #44
            dec e
            jr nz, spf_l
            ld a, (spl_r43)
            SPW #43
            ld a, (spl_r68)
            SPW #68
            ld a, (spl_r15)
            SPW #15
            ld a, (spl_r69)
            SPW #69
            ld a, (spl_r6b)
            SPW #6B
            ld a, (spl_r56)
            SPW #56
            xor a                   ; the border black
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' 1 while any key is down
Private Function Key() As Integer
#asm
            xor a                   ; every half row at once
            in a, (#FE)
            cpl
            and #1F
            ld e, 0
            jr z, spk_n
            inc e
spk_n:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' the splash: n 1 the unicorn, 0 plain, 2 NTC BASIC
Public Sub Show(ByVal n As Integer)
  Dim a As Integer
  a = 0
#If SplashNoLogo = 0 Then
  If n = 1 Then a = LogoAt()
#End If
#If SplashNoPlain = 0 Then
  If n = 0 Then a = PlainAt()
#End If
#If SplashNoNtc = 0 Then
  If n = 2 Then a = NtcAt()
#End If
  If a <> 0 Then Run a
End Sub

' the screen packed at src: in (1 second: 16 steps, 3 frames each), 3 seconds, out (1 second); a key:
' out quickly
Private Sub Run(ByVal src As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer, t As Integer, held As Integer, skip As Integer, hold As Integer
  Begin src
  held = Key()
  skip = 0
  k = 0
  Do While k < 16 And skip = 0
    k = k + 1
    Level k
    For t = 1 To 3
      Frame
    Next
    If Key() = 0 Then
      held = 0
    ElseIf held = 0 Then
      skip = 1
    End If
  Loop
  hold = 0
  Do While hold < 150 And skip = 0
    Frame
    hold = hold + 1
    If Key() = 0 Then
      held = 0
    ElseIf held = 0 Then
      skip = 1
    End If
  Loop
  Do While k > 0
    k = k - 1
    Level k
    Frame
    If skip = 0 Then
      Frame
      Frame
    End If
  Loop
  Finish
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(r As Integer, v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(which As Integer, index As Integer, colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(which As Integer, first As Integer, count As Integer, address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(n As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, pattern As Integer, flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(first As Integer, count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit
Option Memory Reserved &HC000, &H2500     ' <--- NEW   the tile definitions (#C000-#DFFF) and the map (#E000-#E4FF) are in main memory: the program and its arrays kept out

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(x As Integer, y As Integer, t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(x As Integer, y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(px As Integer, py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(x As Integer, y As Integer, w As Integer, h As Integer, t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(x As Integer, y As Integer, s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(x As Integer, y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Fx.cls
files.text:
' Fx - the little asm X-TYPE needs: Shr3(v) = v / 8 for v from 0 (a pixel's cell), with no division loop.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd
Option Explicit

Public Function Shr3(v As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer, mixWas As Integer
Private vv(2) As Integer, stp(2) As Integer, cnt(2) As Integer   ' the volume now, frames a step, to the next
Private silent(2) As Integer       ' 1 = its volume already set to 0

Private Sub W(r As Integer, v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  mixWas = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0 : silent(i) = 1
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ch As Integer, period As Integer, sl As Integer, volume As Integer, frames As Integer, noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise : silent(ch) = 0
  vv(ch) = volume : stp(ch) = 1
  If volume > 0 Then stp(ch) = frames \ volume
  If stp(ch) < 1 Then stp(ch) = 1
  cnt(ch) = stp(ch)
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer, bt As Integer
  ' (CYBORG HELLGATE: the channel's mixer bit kept as it goes, not worked out with ^ each time;
  ' a silent channel's volume written only once)
  mix = &H3F : bt = 1
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      ' the volume down one every stp frames (worked out once, in Play: no dividing every frame)
      cnt(i) = cnt(i) - 1
      If cnt(i) <= 0 Then
        cnt(i) = stp(i)
        If vv(i) > 1 Then vv(i) = vv(i) - 1
      End If
      v = vv(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (bt * 8)
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not bt
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
      If left(i) = 0 Then silent(i) = 0
    ElseIf silent(i) = 0 Then
      W 8 + i, 0
      silent(i) = 1
    End If
    bt = bt * 2
  Next
  If mix <> mixWas Then W 7, mix : mixWas = mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub
